# Meterless H-MEM provenance

Unmodified source files in `src/` come from the official Meterless repository,
`engines/hmem/reference/src/`, pinned to commit:

`a3f15cee1b108c436827cdd10740fd113016e354`

Source: https://github.com/Meterless/Meterless/tree/a3f15cee1b108c436827cdd10740fd113016e354/engines/hmem/reference

The upstream Apache License 2.0 is reproduced in `LICENSE`.
PantryTrace's Python subprocess adapter is original application glue. The
reference is a minimal deterministic implementation, not a production memory
database. Its JSON persistence needs a single application writer.

This is a declared pre-existing third-party component. Do not represent the
upstream engine as new work created for the hackathon.
